|Hayd iduld iddul
|'''Oakum mall yeef athe full'''

==35%==
If A = 1, B = 2, C = 3 and so on… what is the sum total of the word ELF?

The letters of ELF are E = 5, L = 12, F = 6 which means the sum is '''5 + 12 + 6 = 23'''.

==30%==
Isaac goes to visit his Auntie Rose at Christmastime every year; sometimes on Christmas Eve and sometimes on Boxing Day. If the below are his ages when he visited her, what date is Isaac’s birthday?

In 2020 he was 26<br>In 2021 he was 28<Br>In 2022 he was 28<Br>In 2023 he was 30

If Isaac visited on Boxing Day in 2021 and Christmas Eve in 2022 and was 28 for both visits, his birthday must be '''25th December'''.
